caption: The drawing depicts a square quilt composed of hexagonal patches arranged in concentric rings. The central part of the quilt features a single light blue hexagon surrounded by brown, tan, and cream-colored hexagons, followed by a ring of pale blue hexagons, then a ring of dark blue and green hexagons with yellow floral patterns. Outside of that, there is a ring of reddish-brown hexagons with printed designs, then a pink ring, and an outer ring in green and red filled with floral motifs. The quilt is bordered by a band that shares the green and red floral pattern of the outermost ring. The background is a plain off-white color, and the drawing itself is rendered with attention to the textures and patterns found on each fabric piece, reflecting various botanical and geometric motifs in a patchwork style.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
